description: Revise preview-ready asset-pack items with explicit feedback. Use scope "all_items" for pack-wide style or consistency changes, or scope "items" with exact item_ids for specific items. mode: "auto" is the default and lets revised item previews continue to final generation; set mode: "review" only when the user explicitly asks to inspect or approve the revised item previews first. The tool appends normal Mint chat messages when the asset pack has a chat.

riggable_character.description: Set when a humanoid character or character pack is intended for rigging/animation, or when the user asks for an A-pose or T-pose. Presence means empty hands and a strict front-facing camera are required.

hands.description: Required for rigging and animation: the character's hands must be empty with no held props.

pose.description: Animation-ready neutral pose. Use t_pose by default for riggable or animatable humanoid characters unless the user explicitly asks for an A-pose.

name: revise_asset_pack_preview
title: Revise Asset Pack Preview
